captures.description: THE CENTER, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The HathiTrust Research Center (HTRC) is winding down its public services as HathiTrust suspends HTRC funding at the end of 2026.' Key status and details: closure timeline ('Announced in October 2024'); unavailable services ('data capsules, analytics algorithms, and analytics gateway login'), 'as of September 30, 2026'; purpose and origin ('Founded in 2011 as a partnership between Indiana University, the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and HathiTrust'); future direction ('reallocating resources toward emerging technologies and alternative modes of text/data access and machine learning support'); a follow-up offer. Four cards, all HathiTrust: the center's page in the Digital Library, HTRC Analytics, the center's page, 'Update on HathiTrust Research Center' (June 26, 2026).
